verdict.rationale: Support docs describe a dedicated ASC 718 Stock Option Expense Report workflow that outputs an Excel (.xlsx) file of ASC 718 calculations. The platform organizes the inputs (grant types, vesting schedules, plan details), and ASC 718 reporting is listed as a Growth-plan feature. Missing for 10: evidence the output is audit-ready or accepted by auditors, details of the valuation and expense methodology (e.g., option-pricing model, forfeitures), availability on lower-tier plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
